+### DRN-11.01 — The MoT ladder: five compute bands by five resolution steps
+
+**Statement.** Detail and sensing are asked for on a 25-rung ladder, 1.1 through 5.5, where the band is the edge-compute class and the step is the resolution; rung 1.1 is the 1983 vector arcade and is the fastest picture the machine can make.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-11.01.IN` → `DRN-11.01.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § XI — SSSES |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-07` · `U-WF-09` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | ladder monotonic in both axes; 1.1 asks for more frames than 5.5 |
+| DTM target | 25 rungs selectable |
+| Stretch | a robot picks its own rung unattended |
+| Verification | `tests/mot-ladder.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
+
+### DRN-11.04 — Demand and capability are separate, and never mixed
+
+**Statement.** What the picture asks for (the rung) and what the machine can deliver (the HAL class and the measured frame rate) are different quantities held in different modules, and only calibration is allowed to reconcile them.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-11.04.IN` → `DRN-11.04.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § XI — SSSES |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-07` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | a richer rung never asks for a faster picture |
+| DTM target | the old inverted four-tier table is gone |
+| Stretch | the same split serves every 2525 domain |
+| Verification | `tests/mot-ladder.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
+
+### DRN-05.03 — Multi-sensor fusion, shed from the top and never blind
+
+**Statement.** Sensing runs EO, IR, ACOUSTIC, MAG and CHEM, one more module per compute band; when the frame will not hold, modules are shed from the top of that ladder and EO is never shed, because a unit that cannot see is not degraded but blind.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-05.03.IN` → `DRN-05.03.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § V — EDGE |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-09` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | EO survives every degradation path |
+| DTM target | five modules declared per band |
+| Stretch | a real sensor replaces the simulated one behind the same interface |
+| Verification | `tests/mot-ladder.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
+
+### DRN-11.05 — Hold 1080p30, and name every step down from it
+
+**Statement.** The unit tries to hold a 1920x1080 30 Hz reference stream; when it cannot it sheds a sensor module, then resolution, then frame rate, in that order, and every step is named on screen rather than taken silently.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-11.05.IN` → `DRN-11.05.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § XI — SSSES |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-09` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | degradation order fixed; climb needs sustained headroom |
+| DTM target | stream ladder live in the HUD |
+| Stretch | the same ladder drives a real encoder |
+| Verification | `tests/mot-ladder.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
+
+### DRN-11.06 — Self-test: the rung this machine actually holds, in 6 to 15 minutes
+
+**Statement.** Pointed at a new board or a new sensor, the unit walks the ladder from 1.1 upward under real drawing load, measures a sustained frame rate at each rung, and reports the highest rung it holds at the reference stream, inside a declared 6 to 15 minute budget.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-11.06.IN` → `DRN-11.06.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § XI — SSSES |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-06` · `U-WF-09` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | dwell derived from the budget; sweep stops early after two failures |
+| DTM target | a saved result file naming the ceiling |
+| Stretch | run headless on the robot itself |
+| Verification | `tests/self-cal-runner.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
+
+### DRN-11.07 — The robot may pick its own compute class
+
+**Statement.** Three compute classes are declared with their frame budgets and sensor costs, and AUTO lets the unit choose its own class from the frame rate it measures rather than from a label someone typed.
+
+| field | value |
+|---|---|
+| Input / Output | `DRN-11.07.IN` → `DRN-11.07.OUT` |
+| Vision • 2525 | § XI — SSSES |
+| U-WF trace | `U-WF-07` |
+| R-CORE mode | Manual |
+| De-risk phase | pilot |
+| Declared metric M | AUTO thresholds derived from the budgets themselves |
+| DTM target | PI / EDGE-SOC / ACCELERATOR selectable |
+| Stretch | a fourth class added without touching a caller |
+| Verification | `tests/mot-ladder.test.mjs` |
+| Status | **implemented** |
